# Anne Shirley & Davy Keith

- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Friend of — [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) — affectionate towards her · since v2  <sub>[v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071), [v3 ch.Gables P17](../source/v03-c22.md#nw-v03-c22-p0017)</sub>
- [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) — Commands — [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) — under her authority and guidance · since v3  <sub>[v3 ch.Transgressors P18](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0018)</sub>

## Shared scenes

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) brings the twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, home to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), where [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly displays his mischievous and unruly nature. Over the next few days, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) causes trouble by dropping a caterpillar down a girl's neck at church, making [Dora](../character/dora.md) fall into a pigpen, and hiding a toad in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P11](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0011), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P36](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0036), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P49](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0049), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060)_

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he put a toad in Marilla's bed. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) quickly sneaks into Marilla's room and uses a shovel to remove the toad before [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) can find it.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

_Sources: [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P56](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0056), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P60](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0060), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P61](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0061), [v2 VIII Marilla Adopts Twins P62](../source/v02-c08.md#nw-v02-c08-p0062)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to find [Dora](../character/dora.md) missing and everyone frantically searching for her. After searching the well and surrounding area with Mr. [Barry](../character/barry.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) finds [Dora](../character/dora.md) locked in Mr. Harrison's toolhouse by [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md). [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) is confronted and tearfully promises never to lie again after realizing he made [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) cry, though he later questions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about Marilla's warning regarding prayers.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P8](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0008), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P26](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0026), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P34](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0034), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P52](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0052)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) explains to [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) why his lie was the dreadful consequence of skipping his prayers, defending Marilla's honesty. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Davy's mischief and Dora's quiet perfection, agreeing that despite Davy's trouble, they feel a fond affection for him because he needs their guidance.
>
> — v2 · X Davy in Search of a Sensation

_Sources: [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P75](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0075), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P82](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0082), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P84](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0084), [v2 X Davy in Search of a Sensation P89](../source/v02-c10.md#nw-v02-c10-p0089)_

> In a bad mood from a toothache, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) accidentally causes fireworks to explode in the schoolroom and subsequently whips [Anthony Pye](../character/anthony-pye.md) after he puts a mouse in her desk. She goes home heartbroken over her bad day, but [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) comforts her. The next morning, Anthony treats [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) with new respect, and Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) later confirms that the whipping gained his approval.
>
> — v2 · XII A Jonah Day

_Sources: [v2 XII A Jonah Day P19](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0019), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P33](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0033), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P36](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0036), [v2 XII A Jonah Day P49](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0049)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) discusses town matters with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) before returning home to learn from [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) that the twins must stay until fall. After dealing with Davy's jam-stealing and catechism confusions, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) attends an Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvers) meeting where news breaks about [Judson Parker](../character/judson-parker.md) renting his fences for advertisements. The society sends a committee to reason with Judson, but he refuses to change his plans.
>
> — v2 · XIV A Danger Averted

_Sources: [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P0](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0000), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P15](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0015), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P35](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0035), [v2 XIV A Danger Averted P50](../source/v02-c14.md#nw-v02-c14-p0050)_

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) questions [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about heaven after hearing a strange explanation from [Milty Boulter](../character/milty-boulter.md), which [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gently corrects. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) then receives a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) announcing that author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) is coming to visit [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), prompting excited preparations by [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md).
>
> — v2 · XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For

_Sources: [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P11](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0011), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P12](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0012), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P14](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0014), [v2 XVI The Substance of Things Hoped For P24](../source/v02-c16.md#nw-v02-c16-p0024)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) decorate [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) and prepare an elaborate meal in anticipation of guest Mrs. Morgan's arrival. After [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) accidentally ruins the lemon pies and Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) fails to show up, the remaining guests eat a quiet dinner that culminates in the destruction of Aunt Josephine's platter. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) learns via a letter that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) sprained her ankle and will not be coming at all.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P9](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0009), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P28](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0028), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P57](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0057), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062)_

> Following the broken platter incident, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) goes home and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns with a letter from [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) stating that Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) cannot visit. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's tendency to experience emotional highs and lows, plan how to reimburse [Miss Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md), and chat about local gossip regarding Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) before [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) arrives.
>
> — v2 · XVII A Chapter of Accidents

_Sources: [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P62](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0062), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P64](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0064), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P65](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0065), [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P68](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0068)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) talk at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) before [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) signals [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to meet her. [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) informs [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) about a willow-ware platter at the [Copp](../character/copp.md) place in [Spencervale](../codex/places.md#spencervale), and the two girls drive over the next day to get it. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) gets trapped in the roof of an old duck house while trying to look through the window, but after a rainstorm, Miss [Sarah](../character/sarah.md) [Copp](../character/copp.md) returns and releases her.
>
> — v2 · XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road

_Sources: [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P0](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0000), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P15](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0015), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P34](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0034), [v2 XVIII An Adventure on the Tory Road P55](../source/v02-c18.md#nw-v02-c18-p0055)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends time with [Paul Irving](../character/paul-irving.md), sharing tea and discussing his imaginative thoughts and childhood worries. Later at home, she tucks in [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), who deals with his feelings of jealousy toward [Paul](../character/paul-irving.md). Afterwards, she runs into [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) by the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble).
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P2](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0002), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P23](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0023), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P34](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0034), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050)_

> [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) explains his good behavior before going to sleep. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) at the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), where they discuss the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village Improvement Society's ongoing plans and school updates. Upon returning home, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) tells [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) her list of tasks for the next day.
>
> — v2 · XIX Just a Happy Day

_Sources: [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P47](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0047), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P50](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0050), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P55](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0055), [v2 XIX Just a Happy Day P63](../source/v02-c19.md#nw-v02-c19-p0063)_

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) departs with [Dora](../character/dora.md), leaving [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) where she accidentally dyes her nose scarlet while changing feather beds. [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md) unexpectedly arrives with famous author Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) for a visit. Despite her initial embarrassment, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) hosts a successful dinner and walk with the guests before they depart.
>
> — v2 · XX The Way It Often Happens

_Sources: [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P33](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0033), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P42](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0042), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P43](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0043)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to teaching school, where [Dora](../character/dora.md) is frightened by [Mirabel](../character/mirabel-cotton.md) Cotton's stories about a ghost relative. Later, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) walk through the woods to go to [West Grafton](../codex/places.md#west-grafton), but lose their way and discover [Echo Lodge](../codex/places.md#echo-lodge), the quaint stone home of Miss [Lavendar Lewis](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and her young helper, [Charlotta](../character/charlotta.md) the [Fourth](../character/fourth.md). Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) warmly invites them to stay for a imaginary tea party she had set up to combat loneliness.
>
> — v2 · XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar

_Sources: [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P0](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0000), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P7](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0007), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P28](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0028), [v2 XXI Sweet Miss Lavendar P53](../source/v02-c21.md#nw-v02-c21-p0053)_

> At the breakfast table, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) discuss Anne's visit with Miss [Lavendar](../character/lavendar-lewis.md) and gossip about old town affairs while trying to keep [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) in check. Later, word arrives that [Richard Keith](../character/richard-keith.md) has died and left money in trust for the twins, ensuring that [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) can remain living at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) permanently.
>

_Sources: [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P0](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0000), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P9](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0009), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P22](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0022), [v2 XXII Odds and Ends P25](../source/v02-c22.md#nw-v02-c22-p0025)_

> A massive hail and thunder storm strikes [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) on the exact day predicted in a lighthearted newspaper note, causing severe damage across the village. The family at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) weathered the violent hail inside, after which they learn that Mr. Harrison's parrot was killed. Later, [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) visits [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to discuss the storm's destruction and note the destruction of an old blighted house.
>
> — v2 · XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country

_Sources: [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P24](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0024), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P25](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0025), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P43](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0043), [v2 XXIV A Prophet in His Own Country P49](../source/v02-c24.md#nw-v02-c24-p0049)_

> An unexpectedly neat woman arrives at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) looking for Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) and reveals herself to be his wife, [Emily](../character/emily.md), before heading over to his house. The news spreads quickly through the neighborhood, and Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) eventually asks [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to come over so he can explain the whole story of their separation.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P9](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0009), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P16](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0016), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P28](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0028), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P55](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0055)_

> Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) explains the history of his marriage, housecleaning disagreements, and parrot-related falling out with [Emily](../character/emily.md) to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md). [Emily](../character/emily.md) returns from [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) with Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), welcomes [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) to tea, and walks home with her while expressing regret over their past feud. At [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) discusses Mrs. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), while [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) affectionately expresses his fondness for [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) as she puts him to bed.
>
> — v2 · XXV An Avonlea Scandal

_Sources: [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P57](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0057), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P60](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0060), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P65](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0065), [v2 XXV An Avonlea Scandal P71](../source/v02-c25.md#nw-v02-c25-p0071)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) chat about growing up and upcoming changes as they rest in the orchard. After getting a letter from [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) meets [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) on the bridge, but she gets flustered and cuts the moment short when he touches her hand. Returning to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), she comforts [Davy Keith](../character/davy-keith.md) and talks with him before spending a quiet moment dreaming by the brook.
>
> — v3 · Chapter I The Shadow of Change

_Sources: [v3 ch.Change P0](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0000), [v3 ch.Change P20](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0020), [v3 ch.Change P27](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0027), [v3 ch.Change P31](../source/v03-c01.md#nw-v03-c01-p0031)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) leaves [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) amidst tearful goodbyes and travels by train and boat to [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport) alongside [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and Charlie. Upon arriving, she is greeted by [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md), who takes her to their new boardinghouse while chatting gaily to lift her homesick spirits.
>
> — v3 · Chapter III Greeting and Farewell

_Sources: [v3 ch.Farewell P2](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0002), [v3 ch.Farewell P4](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0004), [v3 ch.Farewell P10](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0010), [v3 ch.Farewell P24](../source/v03-c03.md#nw-v03-c03-p0024)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md) settle into college life at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) as their freshman class wins the annual Arts Rush under [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) Blythe's leadership. [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) quickly adopts [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and [Priscilla](../character/priscilla-grant.md), introducing them into Redmond's active social circle. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) receives a bundle of letters from home—including updates from [Jane](../character/jane-andrews.md), Ruby, [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md)—which helps connect her old life in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) to her new life in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport).
>
> — v3 · Chapter V Letters from Home

_Sources: [v3 ch.Home P0](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0000), [v3 ch.Home P2](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0002), [v3 ch.Home P7](../source/v03-c05.md#nw-v03-c05-p0007)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for the [Christmas](../codex/places.md#merry-christmas) holidays and is greeted warmly by [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md), [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), [Dora](../character/dora.md), [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md). Before going to bed, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he was tempted to say a bad word, and she gently helps him process it so he can say his prayers.
>
> — v3 · Chapter VII Home Again

_Sources: [v3 ch.Again P12](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0012), [v3 ch.Again P16](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0016), [v3 ch.Again P34](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0034), [v3 ch.Again P46](../source/v03-c07.md#nw-v03-c07-p0046)_

> Rebelling against Mrs. Lynde's instructions, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) convinces [Dora](../character/dora.md) to skip [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school) and go fishing with the [Cottons](../codex/factions.md#cottons) instead. After lying to Mrs. [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) to cover up his misdeeds, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) suffers from a guilty conscience and late that night confesses everything to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), who forgives him and instructs him to pray for forgiveness.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XIII The Way of Transgressors

_Sources: [v3 ch.Transgressors P23](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0023), [v3 ch.Transgressors P37](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0037), [v3 ch.Transgressors P56](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0056), [v3 ch.Transgressors P94](../source/v03-c13.md#nw-v03-c13-p0094)_

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) spends an evening with [Ruby Gillis](../character/ruby-gillis.md), who tearfully admits her fear of dying and leaving her life behind. [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) offers comfort, but Ruby passes away peacefully in her sleep the following night. After the funeral, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) reflects deeply on life and mortality while walking home with [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) and [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md).
>

> During a stormy holiday break at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) deals with severe winter weather, awkward visits from [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), and Davy's lively chatter. Mr. [Harrison](../character/harrison.md) delivers the mail, bringing letters from college friends and news that Miss [Josephine Barry](../character/josephine-barry.md) has died and left [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) a thousand dollars.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XVIII Miss Josephine Remembers the Anne-girl

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) is reflecting on how much [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) has brightened her life when [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) unexpectedly arrives home a day early from college. The two reminisce and discuss [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), before [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) bursts in and excitedly catches [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) up on his latest antics.
>
> — v3 · Chapter XXII Spring and Anne Return to Green Gables

> [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) sits outside [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), Mrs. Rachel, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md), and [Dora](../character/dora.md), talking about the local news, Davy's schoolwork, and Diana's upcoming wedding. Afterwards, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) walks to the Dryad's [Bubble](../codex/places.md#dryad-s-bubble), feeling sad about how growing up changes relationships and reflecting on her feelings regarding [Gilbert](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) and [Roy](../character/roy-gardner.md).
